title: Diffusion-Pipe LoRA Trainer (SDXL, Wan, FLUX)
description: Multi-model LoRA trainer on tdrussell/diffusion-pipe with Deepspeed pipeline parallelism. Default is SDXL (no token, ~6.5 GiB, 24 GB). Also trains Wan 2.1 / Wan 2.2 and FLUX.1-dev. Send a dataset URL and a trigger word; get a .safetensors LoRA on your Hugging Face repo, S3 bucket or network volume. One GPU by default; set pipeline_stages and gpuCount for 2+ GPUs.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

input.name: Base model
input.description: sdxl is the default (no token, ~6.5 GiB, fits 24 GB). Wan 14B and FLUX.1-dev work best on 48 GB. FLUX.1-dev is gated and needs HF_TOKEN. Override per job with input.base_model. For 2+ GPUs set pipeline_stages to match a GPU count that divides evenly.

input.name: Preset
input.description: Named defaults for steps, rank, learning rate and resolution. Explicit settings win.

input.name: Default trigger word
input.description: Unique token that activates the LoRA, e.g. 'zxowl'. Usually set per job (input.trigger_word).

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz with images and/or videos and same-name .txt captions. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url).

input.name: Training steps
input.description: Optimizer steps (max_steps). ~2000 for a real LoRA; 20 for a smoke test.

input.name: LoRA rank
input.description: 16 is a good default; 32 for a stronger style LoRA.

input.name: Learning rate
input.description: 2e-5 is the diffusion-pipe default (adamw_optimi / AdamW8bitKahan). Do not copy musubi's 2e-4 unless you mean to.

input.name: Resolution
input.description: WxH or a single number (square). Default 1024 for SDXL; use 512 for a quick test. Multiple of 16.

input.name: Pipeline stages
input.description: Deepspeed pipeline parallelism. Default 1 (single GPU). For 2 GPUs set this to 2 and deploy with gpuCount=2. GPU count must be divisible by this value. Incompatible with blocks_to_swap.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the LoRA + model card. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: Private HF repo
input.description: Create the output repo as private.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token. Required for FLUX.1-dev (read) and for HF_OUTPUT_REPO (write). SDXL and official Wan-AI catalogs are public. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Never put the token in the job input.

input.name: Blocks to swap
input.description: auto (default, based on the model and VRAM), 0 to disable, or an integer. Only for LoRA, and only when pipeline_stages=1. The Wan 14B min-VRAM recipe uses 32.

input.name: Training watchdog (s)
input.description: Kill training after this many seconds (0 = off). Keep below the endpoint execution timeout. A cold start may download ~6.5 GiB for SDXL, much more for 14B / Flux.
